title: vaccinium missouriense
intro: Vaccinium missouriense, commonly known as Missouri blueberry, is a deciduous shrub native to the Ozark Mountains in the United States. The plant is rich in antioxidants and has been used for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Missouri blueberry are attributed to its ability to scavenge free radicals, exhibit antimicrobial properties, and modulate the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Vaccinium missouriense include anthocyanins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
